rounds.title: Standings baseline
rounds.note: The SDK standings (et-standings and et-standings-pick), first drawing, drawn by the mocks from @ethlete/components/design/standings with the real markup and CSS: the standings, standings pick, match participant and focus ring sheets. Emblems are the participant's letter fallback, no images. Framed as a 480px page with 16px padding (448px content): at that width the container queries hide the detail and form columns, so the table shows position, team and points; the 800px width shows P / W / D / L / Diff and the form column. Fixtures: six fictional clubs, zones 1-2 'Advances to the playoffs' (the colour theme around the table, brand) and 6 'Relegated' (an app's danger theme), the own team at 4 (data-highlighted). The pick mark (+3 / +1 / 0) is consumer template content in the theme ink. States: table (zones, highlighted row, legend), table-plain (no zones, no highlight, no legend), table-empty (no rows: the lib renders the header row alone), pick (six rows, two advancing, the cut line under row 2), pick-handle-hover and pick-handle-focus-visible (the reorder handle of row 2), pick-dragging (Pinewood lifted 38px towards slot 3, Eastvale slid into slot 4), pick-locked (no handles, the marks shown). Static snapshot: the preview slide drawn at rest. Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2, brand mint, a: mint zone bar vs the zone row tint 1.28 / 11.78 (vs page 1.33 / 13.50); mint legend swatch vs page 1.33 / 13.50; danger zone bar vs its tint 4.35 / 3.56, danger swatch vs page 4.83 / 3.71; zone tint vs page 1.04 / 1.15 (danger 1.11 / 1.04); highlighted row vs page 1.16 / 1.22; muted position vs page 7.81 / 6.94; pick cut line (primary at 50 % opacity) vs page 1.23 / 4.15; pick handle focus ring (et-focus-ring, primary) vs card 1.22 / 11.98 (vs page 1.34 / 13.50); grip vs card 7.10 / 6.16; handle hover tint vs card 1.21, grip on it 13.45; dragged card vs page 1.28 / 1.40 (vs a resting card 1.17 / 1.24); locked card vs page 1.06 / 1.06, its muted name 7.36 / 6.52. Q98 numbers only: no edges; the row lines vs a row 1.23 / 1.48, the head line vs page 1.26 / 1.73; the pick card fill vs page 1.10 / 1.13. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (the pick handle focus ring) and Q99a (the zone bars, the legend swatches and the cut line). The zone row tint (7 %) is a band tint, not a fill or a selected row, so it is kept; the lib has no selected row, so the 32 / 38 / 44 % step does not arise. No mint fill, so no ink edge, so Q102 does not arise and there is no c. Q101 does not arise: no filled button. Lib fixes in this round (76 calls): the draw letter keeps the surface colour on a 25 % surface-colour fill (was 45 %, 3.59:1 in dark), now 9.04-10.39 light / 6.31-7.73 dark (lowest on the highlighted row), so no contrast exception; the zone bar is an inset box-shadow on the position cell (no position: relative, no ::before, flipped under :dir(rtl)), so the row line runs the full row width. Later rounds, left out here: the density and font tokens, a link participant, the seed and subtitle, long names at 480, the locked pick with a consumer theme per mark, touch drag.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light every primary mark is the mint at 1.2-1.3: the zone bars 1.28 vs the zone tint (1.33 vs page), the legend swatch 1.33, the cut line 1.23, the handle focus ring 1.22 vs the card. Dark 11.78 / 13.50 / 4.15 / 11.98. The danger zone bar 4.35 / 3.56.

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88 and Q99a. Q88: the pick handle focus ring (--_et-focus-ring-color inside et-standings-pick) takes the theme ink, light 4.99 vs the card (was 1.22), 5.48 vs page. Q99a: the zone bar (the inset box-shadow, also under :dir(rtl)), the legend swatch and the cut line take light-dark(ink, primary): light mint bar 5.29 vs the zone tint (was 1.28), swatch 5.48 vs page (was 1.33), cut line 2.18 vs page (was 1.23; the lib's 50 % opacity kept); the danger bar and swatch take the danger ink, 5.82 / 6.47 (were 4.35 / 4.83). Dark unchanged: the brand ink is the mint, so dark matches a. Zone and highlighted tints kept. Picked because Q88 and Q99a are the only decided rules that apply, they lift every light mark but the half-opacity cut line past 3:1, and it matches the grid, table and tree picks.
